Consider the function \( f(x) = x^3 - 3x + 2 \). Determine the number of real roots of this function and prove that there is no rational root of this function except for \( x = 1 \).

A set \( S \) of positive integers is called "perfect" if for every pair of distinct elements \( a \) and \( b \) in \( S \), the product \( ab + a + b \) is also in \( S \). Find the maximum possible size of a perfect set \( S \) that contains the number 1.
A sequence of positive integers is defined recursively by \(a_1 = 1\) and \(a_{n+1} = a_n^2 - a_n + 1\) for \(n \geq 1\). Find the smallest positive integer \(k\) such that \(a_k > 10^{100}\).

A sequence of numbers \(a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots\) is defined recursively by \(a_1 = 1\) and for \(n \geq 2\), \(a_n = a_{n-1}^2 - a_{n-1} + 1\). Find the smallest positive integer \(k\) such that \(a_k > 10^{100}\).

A sequence of numbers \(a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots\) is defined recursively by \(a_1 = 1\) and for \(n \geq 2\), \(a_n = a_{n-1}^2 - a_{n-1} + 1\). Find the smallest positive integer \(k\) such that \(a_k > 10^{100}\).
A sequence of numbers is defined as follows: \(a_1 = 1\), and for \(n \geq 2\), \(a_n = a_{n-1}^2 - a_{n-1} + 1\). Find the smallest integer \(k\) such that \(a_k > 10^{100}\).
Find all positive integers \( n \) such that the equation \( x^2 - nx + (n-1) = 0 \) has integer roots.
Find the smallest positive integer \( n \) such that the equation \( x^3 - nx + n - 1 = 0 \) has all integer roots.
